d:
感觉排序稍微乱了一点，将就一下吧。没有有希妹妹是因为作者给开了一个单独的）姐姐的名字有叫玛丽亚有叫玛莎的，当时我看的时候汉化组用的玛莎所以我就用了

The order feels a little messy, so just bear with it. There’s no Yuki Suou because the author made a separate one for her. As for the older sister’s name, I’ve seen both Maria and Masha used, but the fan translation I read used Masha, so I went with that:)

玛莎（Masha） 1-119p
俩人一起（Masha and Alya） 120-198p
艾莉（Alya） 199p-249p
